text:
Maya Chen: quick sync — Optimize toolkit / evals roadmap for the next quarter. Need to lock scope for batching + caching recommendations and the regression-alerting evals. we have customer asks from Acme and BetaBank for per-route cache controls. thoughts on minimum shippable?
Samir Patel: baseline: recommendations engine (static suggestions) + eval harness to detect regressions on prompt sets. per-route controls could be v1.1 unless customers push.
Anya Singh: agree. eng-ml can deliver a rule-based recommender + model scoring pipeline in Q3. full auto-tuning (live rollout) is more infra work.
Matt Rivera: runtime concerns: per-route KV prefix caching requires API layer + runtime hooks. we can expose a simple config flag now, but fine-grained control (per-customer TTLs, invalidation) is more complex.
Olivia Park: from data: to train/eval the recommender we need representative prompt sets + ground-truth quality signals. can Acme share a small anonymized suite? will help reduce false positives in regression alerts.
Evelyn Zhao: design ask — need UX for "suggestions" view + explainability. can we limit scope to one canonical UX pattern for v1? avoids too many polishing cycles.
Samir Patel: proposed launch criteria for v1: (1) recommender returns ranked suggestions for batching/caching (2) evals harness runs nightly on canonical prompt set and alerts on quality regression > 3% (3) docs + sample config + 2 integration examples (hosted, dedicated).
Maya Chen: ok. tradeoffs: if we keep per-route toggles out of v1 we push back on BetaBank ask. BetaBank will likely require per-route controls for their compliance workflows. do we have bandwidth to add a "soft" control (UI toggle + server-side ignore) that we can flip later?
Matt Rivera: we could add a lightweight API flag: "enable_route_cache": true/false. runtime will treat it as a hint. that avoids full invalidation implementation but gives customers a way to opt-out.
Anya Singh: for regression detection we should include both BLEU-style signal and a heuristic for hallucination spikes. will need sample negative prompts in the sets.
Olivia Park: timeline: if we get Acme anonymized set by 2 weeks, we can run an initial evaluation and seed the alerting thresholds. otherwise we'll rely on public benchmarks which may miss customer-specific regressions.
Samir Patel: prioritization matrix: must-have: recommender + nightly evals + docs; should-have: per-route hint + basic UX; nice-to-have: auto-rollout of suggested batching profiles and TTL tuning.
Evelyn Zhao: design resources: I can do the v1 mock in 1 week if engineering agrees on a single UX pattern.
Maya Chen: customers: tally — Acme (push), BetaBank (strict), internal platform (medium). propose we offer BetaBank a short-term workaround: managed config repo + support for manual invalidation via ops.
Samir Patel: ok. blockers: eng-runtime needs schema for config, eng-ml needs prompt sets, and legal needs to sign NDA for customer data.
Matt Rivera: runtime schema draft: 
```json
{
  "route": "/chat/complete",
  "enable_route_cache": true,
  "cache_ttl_seconds": 60,
  "prefetch_batches": 4
}
```
This is a starting point; we'll iterate.
Anya Singh: evals harness minimal API: ingest prompt set, run model variants, compute metrics + alert. keep it as a daily cron job initially.
Olivia Park: alerting thresholds: let's set conservative defaults and expose a way to tune per-customer. default regression threshold = 3% drop vs baseline for quality score.
Samir Patel: cc @deploy-bot to capture a follow-up ticket and assign owners.
deploy-bot: Created ticket "OPT-412: \"Optimize toolkit v1 — recommender + nightly evals\"" — assigned to @Anya, due 2026-04-20.
Maya Chen: next steps: (1) Samir to finalize acceptance criteria doc by Friday, (2) Anya + Matt to review runtime schema and confirm feasibility by Tues, (3) Evelyn to deliver mocks in 1 week, (4) Olivia to coordinate prompt set request with Acme.
Samir Patel: noted. I'll draft the acceptance criteria and ping legal for NDA template for Acme.
Matt Rivera: quick question on metrics — do we include latency/cost impact estimates in v1? we can compute recommended batch sizes and show expected p95 improvement and token-cost delta.
Maya Chen: yes include a simple cost/latency estimate per suggestion in the UI. that maps to OKR: "Reduce per-token cost by 18% via smarter batching/caching".
Anya Singh: final ask: can eng-sre provide sample load traces for realistic batch simulation? that'll help tune prefetch_batches default.
Olivia Park: I'll request traces from eng-sre and try to anonymize.
Samir Patel: thanks all. if no objections we'll lock this scope at the end of week. :thumbsup:
Evelyn Zhao: :+1:
Matt Rivera: +1
Maya Chen: closing — will follow up with the acceptance doc.
